messages.subject: Workshops Part 2
parts:
Hello everybody,

There was a considerable interest in having a get together for
tutoring and general working on R.

I have talked to my boss and she has allowed us to meet and use the
technology at the Cardinal Stritch Madison campus. It is on the West
side, with access to wireless internet and other resources.

The only limiting factor is the meeting will have to be on a Friday
night or a saturday. With finals and Christmas break coming up I think
planing something after the new year would be best.

I would like to know 2 things:

1. Who is still interested?

2. Which would work best Friday, Saturday, or either one?

Nathanael Adams

messages.author: 9f41b096c3f85ddd
messages.subject: Re: Workshops Part 2
parts:
Hi Nathan,

I can do either day, given sufficient advanced notice.

By-the-way. The Memorial Union as well as the UW Biotech Center have
meeting rooms available, if the Cardinal Stritch venue falls through.

Eric Cabot
UWBC
